Create ONE standalone transparent character reaction PNG for Lumi, the approved purple educational game mascot. Image 1 is the nine-expression reference sheet; image 2 is the approved full-body model. Generate a clean INDIVIDUAL ASSET, not another sheet, not a crop with label, not a poster. Preserve exact Lumi identity and 2D cartoon style: swept asymmetric flame-shaped head crown to same side, warm cream eye whites and dark plum eyes, smooth thick dark plum contours, purple skin, lavender oval belly, short rounded arms with mitten hands and thumbs, golden flame tip on curved purple tail attached at viewer right. Same head proportions, face construction, color family, outline weight and tail design as reference. Flat color blocking with only minimal hard-edged cel shading; no glossy 3D lighting, no fuzzy glow, no textures, no new costume or accessory.
COMPOSITION: one torso-up character reaction, crown through lower belly, both hands and the full attached tail tip visible, centered on a square TRANSPARENT canvas. Clean intentional lower-torso crop at about lower belly, consistent bust portrait style like reference sheet. Whole crown, all expressive hands, tail and gesture must fit with at least 12 percent clear margin on all sides. Face should occupy about 40% of canvas width; torso remains visible for gestures. No background, no ground, no shadow, no text, no label, no caption, no watermark, no adjacent characters or panels. Transparent alpha, reusable UI reaction artwork, NOT an animation frame sequence. Keep the chosen expression genuinely distinct and recognizable.
EXPRESSION: HAPPY: match row 1 column 1 of expression sheet. Both eyes open and warm, relaxed eyebrows, gentle open smile, one hand raised in a small friendly wave, other arm relaxed. Calm welcoming energy, not exaggerated excitement.
